body:
Burn-down complete (--status approved). Ready set drained in one wave.

Completed: TASK-1176 — https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/1600
  Adds a terminal `Superseded` status for decision-class specs, so an adopted-then-replaced ADR no longer has to masquerade as Rejected. Superseded-by is a first-class typed edge (SupersededBy/Supersedes), not a string tag. +1349/-51 across 30 files: models.rs, lifecycle.rs, rollup.rs, cache.rs, mcp.rs, schema.rs, proto, TUI store, docs (CLAUDE.md, README, docs/lifecycle.md, lifecycle-vocabulary.md), plan at docs/plans/2026-07-22-task-1176-superseded-decision-state.md.

Caveats / verifications worth noting:
- PR CI green (Build ubuntu-latest, 9m33s). Cross-platform is NOT covered by PR CI — this change touches the serialized status enum and the proto, so it is worth watching tonight's cross-platform nightly before a release cut.
- The post-merge integrated-main check was a compile check only (cargo build -p aida-cli, green), per the BUG-496 gate. The full test suite was run by the implementer pre-merge, not re-run against integrated main.
- I reviewed the diff for the specific hazard of a catch-all `_ =>` arm silently mis-bucketing the new variant. Explicit arms are present in lifecycle.rs, rollup.rs and the cache tally; the epic rollup now subtracts superseded alongside rejected (so a superseded child cannot pin its epic In Progress forever) and is_terminal_epic_status includes it. This is a diff read, not an independent audit of every match site in the workspace.
- Whether to also add `deprecated` was a scope call delegated to the implementer — check the PR body for which way it went and whether it left a Followups bullet.
- Rebuilt target/release afterwards (make build-fast) so the daily-driver binary is not behind HEAD.

Awaiting your sign-off (pickable but NOT queued — I did not act on these): VIS-1, TASK-1164, FR-284.
